description: This file defines a class named CoalescingFSEventsWatcher which manages filesystem event streams on macOS using FSEventStream APIs. It handles starting, stopping, and coalescing rapid file system changes to trigger a callback after a delay.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A class that monitors filesystem events on specified paths, coalesces multiple rapid events, and triggers a callback after a configurable delay.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the watcher with target paths, queue label, delay, notification condition, and change callback.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher and releases resources when deallocated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the filesystem event stream, creating and configuring the underlying FSEventStreamRef.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the filesystem event stream and releases resources.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming filesystem events, coalesces rapid events, and triggers the onChange callback.
